verdicts.reason: A: the robot vacuum is cropped so tightly that the product can't be recognised, and the purple circle ends in a hard vertical cut that looks like a mistake. The outline frame shrinks to a meaningless fragment at the left edge. The headline block is still reasonably sized and sits near the centre. B: the same unrecognisable product crop, and the purple shape is clipped flat on both the right and bottom edges. Oversized dot grids sit over the product photo, and the outline frame floats at random in the middle of the image. The 'Smart Home' text is smaller and the whole group is pushed into the right corner, so B is the messier of the two.
